rules.statement: PoB applies map modifiers such as Resistant as enemy resistance modifiers, including separate elemental and Chaos resistance effects.
PoB represents the Hexproof map modifier as an enemy flag that prevents normal curse application.
PoB applies map monster-life modifiers as enemy Life MORE modifiers, including conditional rare or unique effects.
PoB applies map modifiers that grant monster avoidance for Poison, Impale, and Bleed as enemy avoidance modifiers.
PoB models map monster damage gain as extra by adding a source-to-destination damage modifier on the enemy.
The complete map-modifier catalog and interactions are data-driven and must be indexed from ModMap.lua rather than reduced to a small universal rule list.
